relation_to_discovery: Prospective replication of the 2026-10-05 maintained-isolation temporal-order and fixed-assurance findings. Discovery seeds 76001-76064 and demographic repeats 7101-7108 are not reused.
frozen_claim: Under sustained visitor-replenishment limitation, realized reproductive-assurance change can precede floral-investment decline, but assurance evolution is not required for investment decline. Reduced outcross returns provide an upstream route by which isolation lowers the marginal reproductive value of attraction; pollen-deficit magnitude is not treated as equivalent to viable reproductive output.

primary_cell.rationale: This is the cell in which the 51/64 discovery was defined; it is frozen before confirmatory outcomes are generated.

new_randomization.note: Visitor-history and demographic seeds are new. The founder seed/specification is intentionally held fixed to replicate the original biological starting distribution rather than introduce a third stochastic factor.

sequence_campaign.denominator: all 64 independent visitor histories; each history is first averaged over its eight demographic repeats. Near-simultaneous, investment-first and censored histories count as not assurance-first for the primary binary success proportion.
sequence_campaign.primary_success_rule: In assurance_cost with mutation 0.01 at threshold 0.05, assurance_first proportion >0.50 and the 95% visitor-history bootstrap interval lower bound >0.50.
sequence_campaign.sensitivity_rule: Report the same ordering counts and bootstrap intervals at thresholds 0.025, 0.05 and 0.10 for all four setting-by-mutation cells. Sensitivity outcomes do not alter the primary success rule.

primary_estimands: far investment change from the matched founder mean at period 1000
fixed_assurance_campaign.primary_success_rule: For assurance_cost with mutation 0.01, both investment estimands must be negative and both 95% visitor-history bootstrap interval upper bounds must be <0.
fixed_assurance_campaign.admissibility: At least 90% of the 512 trajectories in each near/far arm must be occupied at period 1000 and at least 60/64 histories must have one or more occupied replicates for the far change and paired near/far contrast; otherwise the confirmatory intervention result is inconclusive, not successful.
fixed_assurance_campaign.secondary_scope: Report the same fixed-assurance estimates for prior_selfing, but do not use that cell to rescue or overturn the frozen primary success decision.

reporting_rules.independent_n: 64 visitor histories. The 8 demographic repeats are nested and never counted as independent ecological replication.
reporting_rules.no_partial_readout: No biological result may be summarized until all 4096 declared trajectories and receipts are present and verified.
reporting_rules.extinction: Trait endpoints after extinction are undefined, never coded as zero. Occupancy and eligible histories are reported explicitly.
reporting_rules.no_retuning: No seed extension, threshold change, tie-window change, outcome substitution, or model-parameter adjustment after execution begins.
reporting_rules.all_cells: All four sequence cells are reported regardless of direction. The main claim is explicitly restricted to the predeclared delayed-selfing/costly positive-mutation primary cell unless a future separately preregistered generality test is performed.
